goldens.reasoning: Golden concerns DeleteCollection storage failure path calling recordLegacyDuration. C3/C4 are in Create/Update; C5 is the reverse swap (legacy op recorded as storage) in the goroutine, a different location.

candidates: In the Delete method, klog.NewContext(ctx, d.Log) uses the base logger d.Log instead of the enriched logger log that includes method-specific values, inconsistent with other methods

In the Delete method, the success path uses name as the third parameter to d.recordStorageDuration while the error path uses options.Kind, creating inconsistent metric labels between success and error cases
In the Create method, when d.Storage.Create fails, d.recordLegacyDuration is called instead of d.recordStorageDuration, recording the Storage operation's duration under the wrong metric
In the Update method, when d.Storage.Update fails, d.recordLegacyDuration is called instead of d.recordStorageDuration, recording the Storage operation's duration under the wrong metric

In the DeleteCollection goroutine, after calling d.Legacy.DeleteCollection, the code calls d.recordStorageDuration instead of d.recordLegacyDuration, incorrectly attributing the Legacy operation's duration to Storage metrics

All four async goroutines (Create, Delete, Update, DeleteCollection) capture errors from Legacy operations but never log them, only using the error to record a boolean in metrics, making debugging legacy write failures harder
